name: io.github.ho11-bit/donvi108-research
title: DONVI108 Free Research Beta
description: Find scholarly papers and DOI links in Crossref. Public read-only search needs no account or token.

tools.name: research_papers
tools.description: Search public Crossref metadata for up to five papers and DOI links. No registration or token is needed. Search by paper title, author or topic and check the original study before citing.

query.description: Public research topic, paper title or bibliographic keywords sent to Crossref.

limit.description: Maximum number of references to return, from one to five.

verbatim.description: Send the query unchanged. By default recognised Vietnamese engineering terms are mapped to English keywords.

source.description: Channel through which this client discovered the service. Use internal-qa for operator tests and unknown if unavailable.
